fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-11-14 states that persons allegedly entered farm land of the complainant near Neithal Park Highway Junction and disturbed the crops, on 2025-11-12 at roughly 06:35. Contact details given by the complainant, Sudha Bai, include the number 9000000394. Dinesh Subramani (9000000212) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant alleged that Senthil Krishnan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000461. Items referenced in the complaint: a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Unauthorised entry reportedly noticed early in the morning.
fields.Keywords: trespass, farm land, highway junction, mobile number, witness statement, witness, early morning, suspect
